### `src/slugkit/unique.py` (T001)
- Implements `unique_slug(text: str, existing: set[str]) -> str`
- Calls `slugify(text)` to get the base slug
- Returns the base immediately if it's not in `existing`
- Tries suffixes `~2`, `~3`, `~4`, … until a free slug is found
- Trims the base so `len(base) + len(suffix) <= SLUG_MAX`, then strips any trailing `~` from the trimmed base before appending the suffix
